verdict.rationale: Qapita is an equity management platform, so syncing stakeholders from an HRIS or payroll system is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions Gusto, Rippling, any other HRIS or payroll integration, or automatic handling of new hires and terminations. The pages cover cap tables, ESOPs, valuations and reporting, and no public OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As an ops user, stakeholders sync from my HRIS/payroll system (e.g. Gusto, Rippling) so new hires and terminations flow into equity records automatically
